units: metres; FBX centimetres (vertices x100, unit scale .01, -Z forward, Y up)
collision: trees: UCX_<mesh>_NN convex hulls in the LOD0 FBX; ferns none
textures: none; linear vertex Color, UVMap local surface coordinates
lod_rule: one design per asset. Beech (NP5): LOD0 keeps the largest even cluster subset filling 96 % of the ceiling; LOD1 keeps every structural branch and secondary (the 2 cm branchlets go) and the largest even subset of the LOD0 clusters that fits, enlarged 1.4; LOD2 drops secondaries and branchlets, one folded quad per kept cluster enlarged 1.8. Ferns keep every frond: crown fern pinnate -> serrated strip -> plain strip; tree fern bipinnate -> pinnate -> flat serrated strip
open_lod_rule: one design per asset; trunks, branches, leaders and lattice twigs kept at every LOD (lattice twigs flat ribbons at LOD1/2, finest lattice levels dropped at LOD2, korari side branches dropped at LOD2); foliage items (straps, pods, leaves, spines, needle sprays) the largest even subset fitting 96 % of each ceiling, enlarged 1.0/1.3/1.55; flax leaves all kept (7 / 3 / 2 across)
floor_lod_rule: one design per asset from seed 57000 + 97 k. Wood (logs, stump, driftwood, log jam): tubes keep every ring column at fewer sides and segments (18/10/6), broken ends and stubs kept at every LOD (stubs with fewer sides), moss colour kept, moss relief shared; hulls UCX convex rings in the LOD0 FBX. Hummocks: one displaced dome at 30/18/8 sectors. Cobbles: clusters keep every cobble and step each one down a detail ladder (icosphere 2/1, dome 8x3/6x2, 4-sided pyramid) with the largest cobbles keeping the finest rung; the bar keeps its shell and drops the smallest cobbles at LOD2 (enlarged 1.55). Boulders: one displaced icosphere at subdivision 3/2/1 clipped at -6 cm. Kiokio: pinnate fronds -> serrated strip -> plain strip
verge_lod_rule: one design per asset from seed 58000 + 97 k. Structure (stems, whips, trunks, branches, roots) kept at every LOD (twigs and whips become flat ribbons at LOD1/2, the finest twig levels drop first); foliage and litter elements (sprays, flowers, blades, seed stalks, leaves, litter twigs, stones, pads) are the largest even subset fitting 96 % of each ceiling, enlarged 1.0 / 1.3 / 1.55 and drawn with fewer triangles per element at LOD1/2; hulls UCX convex prisms on the lower trunk in the LOD0 FBX
farm_lod_rule: one design per asset from seed 59000 + 97 k. Every structural member is kept at every LOD; the sides of round members (posts 12/8/6, bars 8/6/4, wires 3), the rings along them, the grid of each concrete face (vertex colour), the corrugation (pipe pitch 7.5 cm / 15 cm / smooth), the sign lettering (8 blocks / 2 / 1) and the small fittings (weld collars, wire wraps, clamps, hinge eyes) step down. Hulls: UCX convex prisms in the LOD0 FBX. Rows with min_z_band (cattle stop, culvert) are partly buried and are validated against that band instead of the 6 cm root rule
grass_lod_rule: two LODs per asset from one design (seed 60000 + 97 k). LOD0: every blade a narrow tapering strip (4 segments pasture, 5 rank), pasture clover petioles with a three-leaflet head, rank seed-head stalks with 4-5 spikelet quads; LOD1: a six-blade cross of wider strips at 60 degree steps keeping the silhouette and the colour mix (rank LOD1 keeps 4 / 8 single-quad seed stalks). Bases stop 2 cm below ground (rows declare min_z_band). Vertex alpha is a wind weight, 0 at the blade base and 1 at the tip. No collision
patch_lod_rule: three LODs per asset from one design (seed 61000 + 97 k). GS2 LOD0: 110 blades 11-17.6 mm wide in 5-7 tufts (12-16 cm radius, blades fanning outward, 20-50 degree lean, lognormal length median 48 cm range 40-65 cm, three triangles each: base pair, mid pair, point) with short filler blades (median 22 cm, one tapered quad) in the gaps, 8 percent flower stalks 35-50 cm with a 2.5 cm head of four quads (50 white / 30 purple / 20 yellow), 10 percent clover (stalk plus three-quad trefoil); edge tufts lean outward. LOD1: every third grass blade widened 1.6x, every flower stalk with a two-quad head, clover dropped; LOD2: a six-card cross of 70 cm wide strips at the mean blade height carrying the gradient. Bases stop 2 cm below ground (rows declare min_z_band). Vertex alpha is a wind weight, 0 at the blade base and 1 at the tip (clover damped to .2). No collision
